name: skill-builder
description: Create, edit, version and publish portable Agent Skills with SkillJetty by DAF-TECH. Build it. Version it. Ship it.

skillBuilder.skillsDirectory.description: Advanced legacy integration: discovery directory, confined to the preview work folder. This does not move guided drafts, which use the work folder's skills directory.

skillBuilder.projectRoot.description: Work folder for drafts and saved local versions, not the local sharing repository. Leave blank to use the opened folder. Preview uses a .skilljetty-prerelease child; existing data is not moved. After changing folders, save your draft and reopen SkillJetty.

skillBuilder.prerelease.repositoryUrl.description: Sharing repository address for this pre-release, for example https://github.com/your-org/skills.git. Use Workspace settings for this project. An explicitly empty value disconnects sharing; Reset preserves an existing saved connection. The default branch is detected when you verify or submit. Use VS Code Accounts or SkillJetty: Connect GitHub Account to sign in. No credentials belong here.

skillBuilder.prerelease.localRepositoryP.description: Absolute path to the local Git sharing repository, for example C:/AI-Work/Skills-Repository. Choose its top folder containing .git, not .git itself or your draft work folder. An explicitly empty value disables local reuse; upload can use a temporary download. Verify, Pull and Open Skill from Repository are separate SkillJetty commands. Saving this value does not clone or pull.

skillBuilder.distDirectory.description: Advanced legacy integration: ZIP-export directory, confined to the preview work folder. Guided .skill packages instead use releases/<skill>/<version>; this setting does not relocate them.

skillBuilder.claudeCodeSkillsDirectory.description: Advanced legacy integration: destination used by Sync to Claude Code. Leave empty for ~/.claude/skills. This does not select a Git repository or install packages from the current guided workflow.
